findings.problem: States that two RunPage.test.tsx tests gained MSW handlers; only one did.
findings.evidence: git diff HEAD -- web/src/features/run/RunPage.test.tsx adds server.use handlers (the /api/meta handler from T14 and chatThreadOk(() => EMPTY_THREAD) from T17) only in 'moves between tabs with the arrow keys'; no other test uses META or chatThreadOk (T14 report l.68, T17 report l.77).
findings.consequence: The test report lists the existing-test edits (plan 20.4) wrongly, against T21's 'only verified facts' requirement and X-12.
findings.correction: Write: "One of its tests, `moves between tabs with the arrow keys`, gained two MSW handlers (`/api/meta` and the chat thread), as setup only, for the requests the new tabs make."

findings.problem: Says the Playwright specs were run 'one at a time'; four of them ran together in one invocation.
findings.evidence: m3-t19/pw-gate.log: 'Running 204 tests using 1 worker', '204 passed (5.2m)', covering accessibility-m3 (42), keyboard-m3 (60), accessibility (81) and keyboard (21). The 288 results come from three runs: pw-screens-3.log (42), pw-gate.log (204), resume-pw-focus.log (42).
findings.consequence: The test report and design doc describe a verification procedure that was not followed.
findings.correction: In all three places, say the specs were named on the command line, never run as the whole suite, in three runs (screens-m3; accessibility-m3, keyboard-m3, accessibility and keyboard together; focus-m3), so the ui_v2 screenshot spec never ran. Re-run the link and count checks afterwards.
